senses.zh_definition: 西班牙语 gordo 的基本义为“胖的、肥硕的”；此处仅作外语辨识，不能认定为马来语词义，也不能确定输入是否实际指人名或其他专名。
senses.en_definition: Spanish gordo: fat or corpulent; a foreign-language identification, not a verified Malay adjective.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Sepanyol, gordo bermaksud gemuk atau bertubuh gempal; ini ialah penerangan perkataan asing, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.

etymology.historical_story: Spanish gordo has a documented history: the Royal Spanish Academy traces it to Latin gurdus, identified as a word of Hispanic origin. Its present meanings extend beyond bodily size to thickness and figurative magnitude. That history belongs to Spanish. It does not demonstrate that this isolated token is a Malay borrowing or identify any intended proper name. [RAE](https://dle.rae.es/gordo).
